about: What the stage 2 testnet contains and every stand-in it uses. It is deployed fresh on a local chain by ./dev demo at every run, so no address is fixed here: the demo prints the addresses of its run and writes them to .cache/demo/run/addresses.json. The demo reads the node, model, chain and flag values below from this file, so what runs is what this file says.

contracts.node_name: none: the Broker reads its fee split from it
contracts.checks: authority() is the made-up address of the stand-in Parameters with no key; deployed after the five stage 2 contracts, at the address the Broker was given

node.changes: none: the unmodified node, configured by flags alone

price.ticket_face: the job price in micro-USDC plus 1

stand_ins.value: anvil, chain id 474747, one block a second; every key is a throwaway key made by the run
An ERC-20 with six decimals that anyone may mint (contracts/src/money/MockUSDC.sol)
The node prices in wei of the chain's native token. With 1,000,000 of its units to the dollar, one unit is one micro-USDC, so 1 USDC = 1 USD and the node's amounts are micro-USDC
Win probability 2^256 - 2, the largest the node accepts, and a face of the job price + 1 micro-USDC (0.01 USD = 10,000, so 10,001). Each job settles one ticket and overpays 1 micro-USDC (D-06)

stand_ins.stand_in: The signer's ticket limits in micro-USDC
stand_ins.value: --max-ticket-ev 20000 and --max-batch-ev 200000, read as micro-USDC because of the fixed rate above
RoundLength = 50 blocks of the block number the node reads (R-18); a round lasts longer when nobody starts the next one
SmolLM2-135M-Instruct served by llama.cpp; its answers are not checked, and a settled ticket does not show the work was done

Parameters is deployed with an authority address the run makes up and whose key nobody holds, so no change can be announced and every value is the deployment's for every round; no contract has an owner key, and the Controller's names are fixed at deployment.

stand_ins.for: The buyback and burn of LPT (D-13, stage 4)
stand_ins.value: The network half of each fee is held in the Broker (networkHeld) and nothing draws it
